standard_prerequisites: LK derivations of sequents Gamma sequent A
the entailment relation Gamma proves A read off derivability of the sequent
inconsistency as derivability of the empty sequent
core_obligations: Prove compactness for the sequent calculus: (1) if Gamma proves A then a finite subset Gamma_0 proves A; (2) if Gamma is inconsistent then a finite subset of Gamma is inconsistent
proof_roadmap: A derivation of the sequent Gamma sequent A involves only a finite initial sequent, so there is a finite Gamma_0 contained in Gamma with a derivation of Gamma_0 sequent A, which is exactly Gamma_0 proves A
Inconsistency of Gamma gives a derivation of the empty sequent from some finite Gamma_0 contained in Gamma; that finite subset is inconsistent
difficulty_reason: Immediate from the finiteness of sequents in derivations, but the reading of provability and inconsistency in sequent terms must be kept straight.
